title: Maturity gate and gap closure — agent-panel evaluation

panel_protocol.limitation: Source-verified evaluation of maturity dossiers, evidence-debt registers, launch-preparation roadmap DAGs, and mode-governance contracts; live launch-preparation execution, live-provider canaries, operational recovery rehearsals, and external trials remain open gates.

consensus_summary: The multidisciplinary expert evaluation panel reached unanimous consensus approving Track 30 (Maturity gate and gap closure). The core governance assets—including docs/maturity/gap-register.md, conductor/maturity-dossier.json, scripts/check_maturity_dossier.py, PROJECT_STATUS.md, verification/evidence-debt.json, scripts/generate_evidence_debt.py, verification/gate-catalog.json, scripts/check_gate_catalog.py, docs/quality/evidence-debt.md, conductor/launch-preparation-roadmap.json, scripts/check_launch_preparation_roadmap.py, tests/test_launch_preparation_roadmap.py, tests/test_maturity_gap_closure_governance.py, conductor/frontier-plan.md, and context/claim-boundaries.json—demonstrate exceptional architectural rigor, fail-closed claim restraint, and uncompromising traceability. The maturity dossier establishes 17 exhaustive maturity domains and enforces a fail-closed 'not_ready' readiness decision backed by 14 actively tracked critical blockers. The evidence-debt register provides full accounting across all 200 roadmap assertions, tracking 134 open gate entries and 12 track-level-only mappings with a 5-tier priority queue. The launch preparation roadmap coordinates 16 dependency-ordered work packages in a verified acyclic DAG with single-track ownership, executable commands, required receipts, and fail-closed exit criteria, correctly recognizing LP-001 as completed, LP-002/LP-005/LP-006 as partially evidenced, and 12 packages as not started. The mode governance specification cleanly defines Autonomous, Solo, and Team review modes while establishing non-negotiable provenance rules: machine decisions remain attributable, fictional human reviewers and multi-agent ensembles acting as independent human quorums are strictly barred, and current runtime defaults remain locked to human-protected execution. All 16 unit and governance tests pass deterministically. The four higher-evidence operational gates remain preserved as open in the evidence ledger.

assertions_evaluated.statement: Evidence gap register and maturity-domain reconciliation
assertions_evaluated.notes: Evidence gap register and maturity dossier reconcile all 17 domains, 14 critical blockers, and 200 assertions in evidence-debt.json; deterministic checkers pass with zero errors.

assertions_evaluated.statement: Executable hardened/polished launch-preparation work packages with one owning track, dependency order, commands, receipts and exit criteria
assertions_evaluated.notes: 16 work packages in an acyclic DAG with single-track ownership, executable commands, explicit receipt paths, and fail-closed exit criteria verified by 10 deterministic tests.
Fail-closed 'not_ready' decision, gate catalogue capability bounds (no network/no external writes), volatile remote state exclusion policy, and exception visibility verified.

assertions_evaluated.statement: Staged autonomous, solo and team modes with explicit actor provenance and truthful current-capability boundaries
assertions_evaluated.notes: Three review modes, anti-anthropomorphic actor attribution, multi-agent ensemble restrictions, and human-protected runtime defaults verified in specifications and governance tests.
